patch_description:
This implementation improves placement quality through multiple deterministic greedy starts followed by strict local-search refinement for every feasible construction. It directly optimizes the maximum KVPR objective after each tentative assignment, rather than only using current GPU pressure.

The refinement applies improving model moves, swaps, and short two-step chains while preserving memory feasibility. Multiple orderings help reach different local-search basins, and the best refined placement is returned.
